entries.title: Isaiah 1:1
segments: ¶The vision of Isaiah, the son of Amoz, which he saw about Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:2
segments: ¶Give ear, O heavens, and you, O earth, to the word which the Lord has said: I have taken care of my children till they became men, but their hearts have been turned away from me.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:3
segments: Even the ox has knowledge of its owner, and the ass of the place where its master puts its food: but Israel has no knowledge, my people give no thought to me.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:4
segments: O nation full of sin, a people weighted down with crime, a generation of evil-doers, false-hearted children: they have gone away from the Lord, they have no respect for the Holy One of Israel, their hearts are turned back from him.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:5
segments: Why will you have more and more punishment? why keep on in your evil ways? Every head is tired and every heart is feeble.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:6
segments: The body, from head to foot, is all diseased; it is a mass of open wounds, marks of blows, and broken flesh: the flow of blood has not been stopped, and no oil has been put on the wounds.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:7
segments: Your country has become waste; your towns are burned with fire; as for your land, it is overturned before your eyes, made waste and overcome by men from strange lands.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:8
segments: And the daughter of Zion has become like a tent in a vine-garden, like a watchman's house in a field of fruit, like a town shut in by armies.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:9
segments: If the Lord of armies had not kept some at least of us safe, we would have been like Sodom, and the fate of Gomorrah would have been ours.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:10
segments: ¶Give ear to the word of the Lord, you rulers of Sodom; let your hearts be turned to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:11
segments: What use to me is the number of the offerings which you give me? says the Lord; your burned offerings of sheep, and the best parts of fat cattle, are a weariness to me; I take no pleasure in the blood of oxen, or of lambs, or of he-goats.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:12
segments: At whose request do you come before me, making my house unclean with your feet?

entries.title: Isaiah 1:13
segments: Give me no more false offerings; the smoke of burning flesh is disgusting to me, so are your new moons and Sabbaths and your holy meetings.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:14
segments: Your new moons and your regular feasts are a grief to my soul: they are a weight in my spirit; I am crushed under them.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:15
segments: And when your hands are stretched out to me, my eyes will be turned away from you: even though you go on making prayers, I will not give ear: your hands are full of blood.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:16
segments: ¶Be washed, make yourselves clean; put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes; let there be an end of sinning;

entries.title: Isaiah 1:17
segments: Take pleasure in well-doing; let your ways be upright, keep down the cruel, give a right decision for the child who has no father, see to the cause of the widow.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:18
segments: Come now, and let us have an argument together, says the Lord: how may your sins which are red like blood be white as snow? how may their dark purple seem like wool?

entries.title: Isaiah 1:19
segments: If you will give ear to my word and do it, the good things of the land will be yours;

entries.title: Isaiah 1:20
segments: But if your hearts are turned against me, I will send destruction on you by the sword; so the Lord has said.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:21
segments: ¶The upright town has become untrue; there was a time when her judges gave right decisions, when righteousness had a resting-place in her, but now she is full of those who take men's lives.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:22
segments: Your silver is no longer true metal, your wine is mixed with water.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:23
segments: Your chiefs have gone against the Lord, they have become friends of thieves; every one of them is looking for profit and going after rewards; they do not give right decisions for the child who has no father, and they do not let the cause of the widow come before them.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:24
segments: For this reason the Lord, the Lord of armies, the Strong One of Israel, has said, I will put an end to my haters, and send punishment on those who are against me;

entries.title: Isaiah 1:25
segments: And my hand will again be on you, washing away what is unclean as with soap, and taking away all your false metal;

entries.title: Isaiah 1:26
segments: And I will give you judges again as at the first, and wise guides as in the past; then you will be named, The Town of Righteousness, the true town.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:27
segments: Upright acts will be the price of Zion's forgiveness, and by righteousness will men be living there.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:28
segments: But a common destruction will overtake sinners and evil-doers together, and those who have gone away from the Lord will be cut off.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:29
segments: For you will be put to shame because of the trees of your desire, and because of the gardens of your pleasure.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:30
segments: For you will be like a tree whose leaves have become dry, and like a garden without water.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:31
segments: And the strong will be as food for the fire, and his work as a flame; and they will be burned together, with no one to put out the fire.
